458101.overview: Your opponent has just outflanked you—you’re surrounded. Your opponent has the advantage, but can you outwit your adversary in this intriguing game of strategy, skill, and concentration? Do you dare try to maneuver your competitor’s discs, for you know that a surprise move from your challenger could force you to forfeit your turn? This is the provocative contest that awaits you when you play Othello® !
